This is a Signature-original design study, explicitly labeled and never presented as public record. Baseline reference: U.S. Aegis cruiser; 27 built; first Aegis/SPY-1 ships; 122 VLS cells.. The Ticonderoga class — 27 built — was the first class with the Aegis combat system and SPY-1 radar, revolutionizing naval air defense. With 122 vertical-launch cells, Ticonderogas served as air-defense commanders for carrier groups through the Cold War's end and the War on Terror. The last retired in the 2020s.
